snippet.title: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2026
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at gameplay and the world of Mira and the Legend of the Djinns in this latest trailer for the upcoming 2D pixel art-style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. In Mira and the Legend of the Djinns, wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn. Mira and the Legend of the Djinns will be available on PC.
